hook: Genes can predict which way fly color evolves, but not which genes will do the changing.
hook_turn: but not which genes will do the changing.
summary: Fruit fly populations evolved in outdoor mesocosms and in the lab while the team tracked allele frequencies and pigmentation. A genotype-phenotype map stayed stable across populations and correctly gave the direction of change, yet the specific responding loci were largely unpredictable. The finding concerns one trait in one species.
title: Limited genomic predictability of complex trait evolution despite genotype-phenotype stability.
